{{Quote|Someone... anyone... is there anyone out there? This is the ''Aggressive Negotiation''. The... captain and officers have been murdered; we're dead in space and leaking atmosphere. Somebody... anybody... help me!|Gille Narvis|<ref name="Incursion">{{LivingForce|Belted In: Incursion}}</ref>}}
'''Gille Narvis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Gille [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Jarl Narvis]] and together they had a daughter, [[Kalee Narvis]]. She had joint ownership of the company [[Legal Arms Ltd.]] with her husband and served as its accountant. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she traveled aboard the company's [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class freighter]] ''[[Aggressive Negotiation]]'', of which her husband was [[Captain/Legends|captain]], to deliver weapons to the [[Cularin Militia]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, the ship was boarded by a [[Thaereian military]] patrol, who killed Jarl and all of the crew except Gille and Kalee. They planned to kill them last, but were called away, so Gille and Kalee were left in the ship, which was dead in space. Gille broadcast a distress call and the [[Heroes of Cularin]] came to rescue them. She later continued to run Legal Arms Ltd., now as the sole owner.
